emergency.title: Emergency
emergency.dispatchUnavailable: Emergency dispatch is not available on SureCure Visit.
emergency.body: This service only handles planned, non-emergency transport. Nobody on the platform watches for emergencies or sends ambulances. If someone may be in danger, call 108 immediately.

dashboard.title: Transport overview
dashboard.description: Scheduled, non-emergency trips for {name}. Every number comes from current records.
dashboard.expiringNone: No vehicle or driver credentials expire in the next 30 days.
dashboard.expiringUnavailable: Credential expiry could not be checked.

dashboard.noCurrentTrip: You have no trip right now.

fleet.title: Fleet
fleet.description: Vehicles, their verified type and when their permits expire. Only verified, unexpired vehicles can be assigned.
fleet.emptyBody: Vehicles added during onboarding appear here after review.

crew.title: Crew
crew.description: Drivers, their licence status and expiry. Only verified, unexpired, available drivers can be assigned.
crew.emptyBody: Drivers appear here once they accept your organization's invitation.

availability.title: Availability
availability.description: Which vehicles and drivers can take a trip now. This comes from verification and availability records only.
availability.emptyBody: Add vehicles and invite drivers during onboarding.

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: Scheduled transport requests. Accept only with a fresh quote and an assignable vehicle and driver; nothing is accepted automatically.

blocked.quote_inconsistent: Quote does not add up: contact support

requests.acceptBody: Choose the vehicle and driver for this trip. Both are reserved for the pickup window.
requests.accepted: Accepted. The trip has been scheduled.
requests.declineBody: The patient is told the request was declined. Choose the reason.
requests.declined: Declined. The list has been updated.
requests.emptyBody: New scheduled transport requests appear here.

trips.title: Trips
trips.description: Accepted trips. Only the assigned driver records progress; there is no location tracking or arrival estimate.
trips.emptyBody: Trips appear here after you accept a request.

tripDetail.title: Trip {reference}
tripDetail.driverOnly: Trip progress is recorded by the assigned driver only.

driver.title: My trip
driver.description: Your current assigned trip. Later trips appear here when they are due.
driver.laterCount: {count, plural, =0 {No later trips assigned.} one {1 later trip assigned.} other {# later trips assigned.}}
driver.noTripBody: When an assigned trip is due, its pickup and destination appear here.
driver.confirmBody: This updates the trip status for the patient and your operator.
driver.interruptTitle: End this trip because of a problem?
driver.interruptBody: The trip ends and your operator is told. If anyone is in danger, call 108 first.
driver.done: Saved. Your trip has been updated.

billing.title: Billing
billing.body: Trip payments and settlements are not connected yet. Pay-after collections will be recorded here once the payment contract is approved.

support.title: Support
